fix.summary: Sustained at current HEAD `52bdbac`. In `src/recorder/extract.ts:63-66`, `diagnostic.details ?? {}` and `diagnostic.error ?? {}` erase the distinction between absence and a present nullish value. Independent execution through `AcceptanceCollector` confirms that otherwise valid terminating issuances with `diagnostics: [{ type, timestamp, details: null }]` and, separately, `error: null` are both accepted. The tracked `dist/recorder/extract.js:52-55` contains the same generated defect. Repair only `validDiagnostics` at the existing native assistant-envelope seam: for each optional field `details` and `error`, admit absence or the existing non-array, non-null record shape, and reject a present `null` (and present `undefined`, the same nullish-coalescing defect at the parser seam). Preserve the validator's remaining diagnostic contract and all other Issue #36/#33 behavior; do not redesign diagnostic error internals or add another validator. Add focused parser mutations independently covering `details` and `error` as omitted, valid records, null, and present undefined, with malformed present values ending `acceptance-invalid`. Rebuild with the repository Recorder build so `dist/recorder/extract.js` is synchronized, and verify focused source plus generated/packed Recorder behavior and `git diff --check`.
